# Fulfilment and delivery

Shipping and delivery after an order is placed, including delivery problems the customer reports.

[All domains](README.md)

## `delivery_attempted`

A delivery was attempted but not completed.

**Sources:** webhook · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shipment.id` | string | yes |  |

Other fields come from the `shipment` block.

```json
{
  "shipment": {
    "id": "id_1"
  }
}
```
